instruction: I want to disable minimal view mode in VLC so I can see all the controls and menu options. How can I switch back to the full interface mode?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling minimal view mode in VLC (qt-minimal-view=0). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file. Default is 0 (full interface), task ensures it stays at 0.

Expected value (0) is semantically correct - disabling minimal view means qt-minimal-view=0 (full interface mode)
